name: DIAGONAL_STRIPES_BLACK_ON_WHITE_TALL
notes: Illust. D4-3A(L,R) 225x450 R25. (L): black 45-degree stripes descending to the right. The perpendicular chain is read literally, from the top-right corner inwards along the diagonal: white 71 (corner), black 64, white 64, then black/white 64 alternating (64 perpendicular = 90.51 along an edge, 71 = 100.41). Boundaries (x - y): 124.59, 34.08, -56.43, -146.94, -237.45, -327.96; three black stripes; the bottom-left corner white (450 - 327.96 = 122 along the edge, 86 perpendicular) is not dimensioned and follows from the chain. The drawn image shows equal-width black and white stripes with larger whites at both corners, consistent with this reading. (R) is the mirror image.
